title: A joint astrophysical uncertainty band on everything inferred from the LZ event: rho0, v0, v_esc, v_sun, the tail shape and the halo frame
question: Propagating a joint prior over rho0 (0.3-0.5, log-uniform), v0 (220-250), v_esc (500-600 km/s, correlated +0.5 with v0), V_sun (+-5 km/s), Lisanti tail index k (0-2) and the frame convention (Sun/16 June/annual) through Latin-hypercube Monte Carlo, what are the marginal 68/95% bands and correlations of d10, kappa(delta), the Higgsino delta(N=1), delta_max, the modulation amplitude a1 and the 248 keV percentile, which input dominates each, and how do they compare with P043's detector systematics?
headline_result: v_esc dominates every inelastic quantity (first-order index 0.57-0.91): Higgsino delta(N=1) = 355 (+30/-26) keV, delta_max(June) = 390 (+31/-32) keV, kappa(366) spans 3e-3-150 (68%) with 13% of halos giving no event; rho0 alone sets d10 = 0.246 (+0.023/-0.020) = 0.279 (rho0/0.3)^-1/2 +- 1.3%; the frame convention carries <= 4% of any variance; astrophysics exceeds P043's detector systematics by x5.5 (d10), x11 (delta_max), x19-300 (kappa) but is x0.33 for the 248 keV percentile at delta = 300 keV, which stays > 99th (99.16-99.53)
model_or_mechanism: Latin-hypercube joint halo prior with Gaussian-copula v0-v_esc correlation; isotropic Earth-frame eta(v_min) by 1D Gauss-Legendre cap integral (P018 method) for Lisanti-form tails; cached WimPyDD per-stream kernels (O1 isoscalar unit coupling, P007 Higgsino, P012 L10; 1 TeV; LZ efficiency; 2.84 t yr) x delta_eta in Sun/June/annual frames; rho0 scaling; binned first-order (Sobol-like) variance indices; comparison with P043
confidence: medium - construction validated against P018/P007/P012/P002/P034; bands inherit recalled prior ranges and an assumed +0.5 correlation
agent_tools: Read x19, Bash x22, Write x5, Edit x21, Skill x1 (dataviz), ToolSearch x1, TaskStop x1
